name: Bofyne Unit: The Omega Contract
storyline: Meet The Bofyne Unit, a special team of western themed cosplayers who boasts of an extremely high success rate for various services such as Body Guarding, Item Retrieval, and “Message Sending” Nothing stands in the way of a successful mission, not even laws! Being a well-known successful 4-hire team, Cosbattle Champion Besticca has tasked The Bofyne Unit with the dismantling of a rival cosbattler, a ruthless high powered mecha cosplayer who has publicly made a vow to “Bring Besticca to her knees”. Will the Bofyne Unit be able to take down the mysterious mechanized threat ,only known as Omega before the cosbattle championship or will this be the end of the line for the team?!
